businesses.business: identity verification and secure biometric platform

offering_description.value: Operates a biometric identity platform that lets consumers verify their identity at airports, venues and online. Sells paid consumer memberships and identity verification services to businesses and government partners, delivered through enrollment pods, kiosks and a mobile app.

primary_products.value: biometric identity verification platform; consumer identity membership; verification kiosks and enrollment pods; mobile identity app

primary_services.value: expedited airport security screening; identity verification and authentication; digital identity credentialing; venue access verification

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual travelers and consumers buying paid memberships; B2B: airlines, airports, sports venues, healthcare providers and enterprises needing identity verification; B2G: TSA and other government agencies using identity verification programs

end_markets.value: air travel; sports and entertainment venues; healthcare; financial services; consumer identity

revenue_model.value: subscription: annual consumer memberships for expedited identity verification; service fees: partner fees for identity verification and credentialing; transaction or usage fees: per-verification fees from enterprise identity customers
revenue_model.category: subscription; service fees; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: biometric identity platform and app serving consumers and enterprise partners; service provider: enrolls members and verifies identity at airports and venues for travelers and partners

geography_served.value: US national: airports, venues and partners across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: consumer membership, airport screening and enterprise identity verification on one biometric platform

distribution_channels.value: own locations: enrollment pods and kiosks in airports and venues; online: mobile app and website membership signup; partners / resellers: airline, card and enterprise partnerships and integrations

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: biometric data privacy laws, TSA security program requirements and FTC consumer protection rules
